turns.user: I have knee pain and burning sensation
turns.ai: Dear friend, your knee pain points to Vata‑driven Sandhivata while the burning sensation reflects Pitta‑aggravated Amlapitta. Warm ginger‑garlic decoction twice daily, a gentle massage of the knee with Mahanarayan Taila and nightly Triphala powder can pacify both doshas, and Yograj Guggulu can support the joints. Follow a pathya of cooked millets, warm vegetables, ginger‑spiced soups and avoid sour, spicy, fried foods, cold dairy and excess caffeine. Gentle walking, knee‑friendly yoga and regular meals will help restore harmony.

turns.user: what herbs should I take for this?
turns.ai: You can consider Yograj Guggulu, Mahanarayan Taila for knee massage, Triphala powder, and a warm ginger‑garlic decoction to balance Vata and Pitta.
